description.en: By bus round the lakes: the 555 from Keswick to Grasmere, Ambleside and Windermere comes about every hour. Auntie Edna knows every timetable: a single or a return, and where to get off.
description.sl: Z avtobusom med jezeri: številka 555 iz Keswicka vozi približno vsako uro. Teta Edna pozna vse vozne rede: enosmerna ali povratna vozovnica in kje izstopiti.
description.it: In autobus tra i laghi: il 555 da Keswick a Grasmere, Ambleside e Windermere passa più o meno ogni ora. La zia Edna conosce tutti gli orari: sola andata o andata e ritorno, e dove scendere.
description.de: Mit dem Bus durch den Lake District: Der 555 von Keswick nach Grasmere, Ambleside und Windermere kommt etwa jede Stunde. Tante Edna kennt alle Fahrpläne: einfach oder hin und zurück, und wo man aussteigt.

review: de, sl, en, it: machine-written, not reviewed by a native speaker

words.example_en: The bus stop is outside the post office.
words.example_it: La fermata dell'autobus è davanti all'ufficio postale.
words.example_de: Die Bushaltestelle ist vor der Post.
words.note: Hold out your arm when the bus comes, so it stops for you.
words.note_sl: Ko pripelje avtobus, iztegni roko, da se ustavi zate.
words.note_it: Quando arriva l'autobus, alza il braccio perché si fermi.
words.note_de: Wenn der Bus kommt, streck den Arm aus, damit er für dich hält.

words.example_en: The bus to Kendal leaves from the bus station.
words.example_sl: Avtobus za Kendal odpelje z avtobusne postaje.
words.example_it: L'autobus per Kendal parte dalla stazione degli autobus.
words.example_de: Der Bus nach Kendal fährt vom Busbahnhof ab.
words.note: A bus stop is by the road; a bus station is a place where many buses start.
words.note_sl: Bus stop je postajališče ob cesti; bus station je postaja, s katere odpelje veliko avtobusov.
words.note_it: Bus stop è la fermata sulla strada; bus station è il posto da cui partono tanti autobus.
words.note_de: Bus stop ist die Haltestelle an der Straße; bus station der Busbahnhof, wo viele Busse abfahren.

words.example_en: The timetable is on the bus stop.
words.example_de: Der Fahrplan hängt an der Haltestelle.
words.note: Americans say schedule. At school the timetable shows the lessons of the week.
words.note_sl: Američani rečejo schedule. V šoli je timetable urnik.
words.note_it: Gli americani dicono schedule. A scuola il timetable è l'orario delle lezioni.
words.note_de: Amerikaner sagen schedule. In der Schule ist der timetable der Stundenplan.

words.example_en: You buy your ticket from the driver.
words.example_de: Die Fahrkarte kaufst du beim Fahrer.
words.note: On country buses you pay the driver when you get on.
words.note_sl: Na podeželskih avtobusih plačaš vozniku, ko vstopiš.
words.note_it: Sugli autobus di campagna paghi l'autista quando sali.
words.note_de: In Landbussen zahlst du beim Einsteigen beim Fahrer.

words.example_it: Una sola andata per Keswick, per favore.
words.note: There and not back. A single room is a room for one person.
words.note_sl: Samo tja. A single room pa je enoposteljna soba.
words.note_it: Solo andata. A single room è invece una camera singola.
words.note_de: Nur hin. A single room ist dagegen ein Einzelzimmer.

words.it: il biglietto di andata e ritorno
words.example_it: Un'andata e ritorno per Grasmere, per favore.
words.example_de: Einmal Grasmere hin und zurück, bitte.
words.note: There and back. Americans say round trip.
words.note_sl: Tja in nazaj. Američani rečejo round trip.
words.note_it: Andata e ritorno. Gli americani dicono round trip.
words.note_de: Hin und zurück. Amerikaner sagen round trip.

words.example_en: Say thank you to the driver when you get off.
words.example_de: Bedank dich beim Aussteigen beim Fahrer.
words.note: In Britain people say Thanks! or Cheers! to the driver.
words.note_sl: V Britaniji vozniku rečejo Thanks! ali Cheers!
words.note_it: In Gran Bretagna all'autista si dice Thanks! o Cheers!
words.note_de: In Großbritannien sagt man zum Fahrer Thanks! oder Cheers!

words.note: What you pay for the ride. Fair (just, right) sounds the same.
words.note_sl: Kar plačaš za vožnjo. Fair (pošten) se izgovori enako.
words.note_it: Quello che paghi per il viaggio. Fair (giusto) si pronuncia uguale.
words.note_de: Was du für die Fahrt zahlst. Fair (gerecht) klingt gleich.

words.note: On a double-decker, sit upstairs at the front: the best view of the lakes!
words.note_sl: Na dvonadstropnem avtobusu sedi zgoraj spredaj: najlepši razgled na jezera!
words.note_it: Sull'autobus a due piani siediti di sopra, davanti: la vista più bella sui laghi!
words.note_de: Im Doppeldecker oben vorne sitzen: die beste Aussicht auf die Seen!

words.note: Press the bell before your stop.
words.note_sl: Pred svojim postajališčem pritisni na zvonec.
words.note_it: Prima della tua fermata premi il pulsante di prenotazione.
words.note_de: Vor deiner Haltestelle drückst du die Klingel.

words.example_en: We get on the bus in Keswick.
words.example_de: Wir steigen in Keswick in den Bus ein.
words.note: Get on a bus, a train or a bike; but get into a car.
words.note_sl: Get on (na avtobus, vlak, kolo); v avto pa get into.
words.note_it: Get on per autobus, treno e bici; in macchina invece get into.
words.note_de: Get on bei Bus, Zug und Fahrrad; ins Auto aber get into.

words.example_en: Where do I get off for the lake?
words.example_de: Wo steige ich zum See aus?
words.note: Get off the bus; but get out of a car.
words.note_sl: Get off the bus; iz avta pa get out of.
words.note_it: Get off the bus; dalla macchina invece get out of.
words.note_de: Get off the bus; aus dem Auto aber get out of.

words.example_en: Do I need to change? – No, the 555 goes straight there.
words.example_sl: Moram prestopiti? – Ne, 555 pelje naravnost tja.
words.example_it: Devo cambiare? – No, il 555 va diretto.
words.example_de: Muss ich umsteigen? – Nein, der 555 fährt direkt hin.
words.note: Change is also the coins you get back: Here's your change.
words.note_sl: Change je tudi drobiž, ki ga dobiš nazaj: Here's your change.
words.note_it: Change è anche il resto: Here's your change.
words.note_de: Change ist auch das Wechselgeld: Here's your change.

words.example_en: The bus is ten minutes late.
words.example_it: L'autobus è in ritardo di dieci minuti.
words.example_de: Der Bus hat zehn Minuten Verspätung.
words.note: For people too: Sorry I'm late!
words.note_sl: Tudi za ljudi: Sorry I'm late! (Oprosti, ker zamujam!)
words.note_it: Anche per le persone: Sorry I'm late! (Scusa il ritardo!)
words.note_de: Auch bei Menschen: Sorry I'm late! (Entschuldige die Verspätung!)

words.note: On time: at the right time. In time: early enough.
words.note_sl: On time: ob pravem času, točno. In time: dovolj zgodaj, pravočasno.
words.note_it: On time: all'ora giusta. In time: in tempo.
words.note_de: On time: pünktlich. In time: rechtzeitig.

words.example_it: Il 555 passa più o meno ogni ora.
words.note: Also: every half hour, every ten minutes. Hourly: every hour.
words.note_sl: Tudi: every half hour (vsake pol ure), every ten minutes. Hourly: vsako uro.
words.note_it: Anche: every half hour (ogni mezz'ora), every ten minutes. Hourly: ogni ora.
words.note_de: Auch: every half hour (jede halbe Stunde), every ten minutes. Hourly: stündlich.
